pictures.author: J.N.Gupta
pictures.observations: Whole960x720 front: high coursed stone platform and central six-step approach; open carved square-pier mandapa beneath a modern shallow sheet canopy, broken carved front stumps. No tall intact shikhara visible. Rear pale sanctum wall/open central door.

pictures.author: J.N.Gupta
pictures.observations: Whole500x667 axial interior: cream Nandi on a small blue/pale tiled pedestal, carved square doorway with open pale paired metal grilles, raised sanctum threshold and dark lingam; weathered pale inner wall.

pictures.author: J.N.Gupta
pictures.observations: Whole960x720: broken tapered square carved stumps along low platform, worn chamfered edges and original simplified leaf/band relief. Pictured date differs from the adjacent April pictures; keep supplied date.

pictures.author: J.N.Gupta
pictures.observations: Whole960x720 fills the concrete coverage gap at the sanctuary ceiling: receding square/octagonal corbel rings and small central rosette. Do not invent an intact exterior tower.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Ancient Shiva Temple Bhainsdehi, pictured2013 standing state: raised coursed stone platform/central approach, open carved square-pier hall with modern shallow sheet shelter, broken front carved stumps, low rear sanctuary with real doorway and receding corbel ceiling. Small original simplified Nandi/lingam silhouettes; no copied religious sculpture, inscriptions or photographic atlas. No invented complete shikhara.
